basic_info.description: Sophisticated City Living at the SOMA Grand! This stunning corner residence boasts sweeping south and west views. Designed with an open floor plan, the home features a spacious chef's kitchen equipped with stainless Bosch appliances, CaesarStone countertops, and sleek European cabinetry. The primary bedroom offers a luxurious en-suite bathroom with dual sinks, while the second bedroom serves perfectly as a guest room or home office, complete with exceptional views. Additional highlights include hardwood flooring, Bi-monthly housekeeping, custom closet systems, in-unit washer and dryer, and one-car parking in a secured, gated garage.
